text: Motuna is a South Bougainville language spoken by about 7,000 people mainly in the Siwai Rural LLG in the southwest of the Autonomous Region of Bougainville in Papua New Guinea. Motuna is also known as Siwai, Siuwai or Siuai.

title: A grammar of Motuna (Bougainville, Papua New Guinea)
text: This thesis is a descriptive grammar of Motuna, a Non-Austronesian language spoken by several thousand people in the south-western part of Bougainville (called Siwai), Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Buin Family of the Eastern Bougainville stock, in the Bougainville Phylum.
